hierarchical_pairing: resample five synthetic path IDs and independent circular session blocks per path; same indices for candidate/baseline
acceptance: candidate positive net and g; positive paired mean log-return LCB for every block length; candidate DD <= baseline and8%; all five paths positive net at costs1.5 and2; at least20 closures per path; no real-market promotion from synthetic
effective_n: HAC truncation10, capped at observed paired session count; report five independent synthetic paths separately
MDE: one-sided family critical plus80pct power normal approximation times cross-seed standard error, label approximate
status_precedence: nonpositive net -> REJECTED; positive but failed intervals, insufficient closures or scenario robustness -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; else RESEARCH_ACCEPTED_SYNTHETIC_ONLY
